title: Reading lab: Luke 5:17–26
subtitle: Compare a parallel narrative without flattening it.
overview: Luke’s parallel scene gives practice in observing another author’s wording, setting, and discourse flow. Comparison comes after each passage is read on its own terms.
Track Luke’s setting clause, the faith observation, the inner reasoning, and the concluding response.

items.grc: καὶ ἦν διδάσκων, καὶ ἦν δύναμις κυρίου εἰς τὸ ἰᾶσθαι αὐτόν.
items.en: And he was teaching, and the Lord’s power was present for him to heal.

items.grc: καὶ ἔκστασις ἔλαβεν ἅπαντας καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεόν.
items.en: And amazement seized them all, and they were glorifying God.
